description: This file defines the GuarantorFundingTransaction entity class, representing a transaction related to guarantor funding within the loan account guarantor domain. It contains mappings for database persistence, relationships to other entities, and business logic to reverse a transaction.

classes.name: GuarantorFundingTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a guarantor funding transaction, persisting details about the transaction, such as related guarantor funding details, associated loan transaction, deposit hold transaction, and reversal status.

methods.name: GuarantorFundingTransaction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the guarantor funding transaction with related details and setting reversal status to false.

methods.name: reverseTransaction
methods.description: Business method to reverse the transaction if it is not already reversed; marks it as reversed, reverses the hold transaction, and undoes the release of funds if applicable.
